title: Deterministic practical-usable-range derivation from explicit typed assumptions (contract-free service function; consumes the scenario document; never touches the canonical draft cap; never Verified)
objective: Add a pure, deterministic, OFFLINE service function that derives an ILLUSTRATIVE practical-usable-range (min/point/max) from a preliminary scenario document PLUS its explicitly-declared typed assumptions (e.g. utilization_factor, efficiency_ratio), WITHOUT ever mutating or recomputing the canonical draft_zoning_floor_area_cap_sq_ft and WITHOUT inferring any missing envelope constraint. This is the first optimization-side brick under M5 and it fills the Compare UI's currently-empty practical-usable-range. HARD BOUNDARIES: (1) contract-free - return a NEW separate derived object from a new module services/api/app/scenario/derive.py; do NOT edit packages/contracts/** or any canonical schema, do NOT edit builder.py/models.py/constants.py/contract.py (consume READ-ONLY). (2) The canonical cap is transported verbatim and is NEVER the derived range; the derived range is clearly a function of the cap x explicitly-declared factors, labelled illustrative/derived, never gross/net/sellable/feasible/buildable, never Verified (coverage tops out at conditional). (3) With NO assumptions the derived range == the raw cap (no hidden utilization/efficiency/optimization default is ever applied - prove it). (4) Fail closed on malformed/non-finite/negative/out-of-domain factors (NaN/Inf/wrong-type) - typed outcome, no crash, no NaN/negative output; deterministic byte-identical output for identical input. (5) Preserve provenance/needs_review lineage; emit the not_verified_disclaimer discipline. Wire the new function through services/api/app/scenario/__init__.py exports only. TOOL DISCIPLINE: orient with Read/Grep/Glob; do NOT use Bash for git/ls/cat/find; only WRITE files inside allowed_paths and RUN the documented_test_commands; the orchestrator commits at the gate.
business_reason: M5 scenario/optimization-engine depth (D-038-R003 menu), no-credentials + locally pytest-testable + not G6-acceptance-blocked (pure derived math, no new legal rule) - the acceptable backend work the owner chose 2026-09-08 while M5-T004 UI is parked. Directly fills the parked Compare UI's 'practical usable range cannot be derived yet' with an honest, explicit-assumption-only derived range.
forbidden_paths: project-control/** (except services/api/... and the own producer report above)
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 raw-cap passthrough (no hidden default): a preliminary R5 document with NO assumptions -> the derived practical-usable-range equals the raw draft cap exactly (min==point==max==draft_zoning_floor_area_cap_sq_ft, e.g. 15000); test proves no utilization/efficiency/optimization factor is silently applied; the cap field itself is byte-identical to the input.

AS-2 explicit-factor derivation: a document + explicitly-declared typed assumptions (e.g. utilization_factor=0.8, efficiency_ratio) -> range endpoints are a deterministic, documented function of the CANONICAL cap x the declared factors (e.g. 15000*0.8=12000), surfaced as a clearly-labelled DERIVED/illustrative figure; the canonical draft_zoning_floor_area_cap_sq_ft is transported VERBATIM and never replaced by the derived range.

AS-3 fail-closed on bad factors: NaN / +/-Inf / negative / zero / non-numeric / out-of-domain assumption -> typed fail-closed outcome (no crash, no NaN/negative/Inf in output, no partial range); the canonical cap is never mutated.
AS-4 no-cap document: a no_scenario / unsupported document (no cap) -> NO derived range; a typed 'not derivable' outcome with a visible reason, never a fabricated number.
AS-5 determinism: identical (document, assumptions) input -> byte-identical derived output (endpoints, labels, reasons, provenance).

AS-6 never-Verified + honest labelling: exhaustive check that no derived field == 'verified'; the derived range is never labelled gross/net/sellable/feasible area or a buildable envelope; needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer lineage preserved end-to-end.

AS-7 contract-free + read-only + offline: zero modification to packages/contracts/** or builder.py/models.py/constants.py/contract.py; the input scenario document is consumed READ-ONLY and re-validates unchanged via validate_scenario_document; runs fully offline with fixtures (no Supabase, no Geoclient, no network) - D-038-R004.
